claims.claim: Fiscal Q3 sales rose 23% to $2.741B and year-to-date organic sales growth was 10%; management raised full-year sales and EBITDA guidance after bookings exceeded expectations.

risks: higher interest expense offsets operating growth
leveraged acquisition model increases financing sensitivity
contradictions: Sales and EBITDA are growing strongly while year-to-date EBITDA As Defined margin of 52.6% is below 53.8% a year earlier, so growth quality requires mix and acquisition-dilution monitoring.
unknowns: duration of booking strength across commercial and defense channels
normalized margin of recent acquisitions after integration

recommendation.reason: Primary current results provide reusable demand, margin and guidance evidence.
